stem: A single card is drawn at random from a standard deck of 52 playing cards. What is the probability that the card is either a heart or a king?

per_option_rationale.rationale: P(heart or king) = P(heart) + P(king) - P(heart and king) = 13/52 + 4/52 - 1/52 = 16/52 = 4/13.
Student computed P(not heart and not king) = 36/52 = 9/13, the complement of the required event.
Student treated 'or' as 'and' and computed P(heart) x P(king) = (13/52)x(4/52) = 52/2704 = 1/52.
Student added P(heart) and P(king) without subtracting the overlap: 13/52 + 4/52 = 17/52.

explanation: Use the addition rule: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B). There are 13 hearts, 4 kings, and 1 card (king of hearts) that is both; (13 + 4 - 1)/52 = 16/52 = 4/13.
